subject: Matemática
description_pt: Indicar a duração de intervalos de tempo entre duas datas, como dias da semana e meses do ano, utilizando calendário, para planejamentos e organização de agenda.

components.description_pt: Capitalizar datas, incluindo dias da semana e meses do ano, na escrita
components.description_en: Capitalize dates, including days of the week and months of the year, in writing

components.description_pt: Determinar a duração de intervalos de tempo em dias usando um calendário
components.description_en: Determine the duration of time intervals in days using a calendar
components.cc_component_description: Use the four operations to solve word problems involving distances, intervals of time, liquid volumes, masses of objects, or money

components.description_pt: Aplicar cálculos de intervalos de tempo baseados em calendário para planejamento e organização de cronogramas
components.description_en: Apply calendar-based time interval calculations to planning and schedule organization
components.cc_component_description: Measure time intervals in minutes (within 60 minutes), including finding elapsed time

cc_matches.description: Tell and write time to the nearest minute and measure time intervals in minutes. Solve word problems involving addition and subtraction of time intervals in minutes, e.g., by representing the problem on a number line diagram.

Use the four operations to solve word problems involving distances, intervals of time, liquid volumes, masses of objects, and money, including problems involving simple fractions or decimals, and problems that require expressing measurements given in a larger unit in terms of a smaller unit. Represent measurement quantities using diagrams such as number line diagrams that feature a measurement scale.
